The technology stack behind FinAI

🧠

FinBERT

A BERT Transformer pre-trained on financial text (annual reports, SEC filings, earnings calls). Understands domain jargon like EBITDA, headwinds, and forward-looking statements.

🔍

LIME / SHAP (XAI)

Explainable AI libraries that highlight which words and phrases drove the model's decision, opening the "black box" for human verification and trust.

📊

Sentiment Analysis

Classifies financial text as Positive, Neutral, or Negative with a confidence score. Goes beyond word counting to understand context and tone.

📝

NLP Summarisation

Extracts the most important key points from long financial documents, saving analysts hours of reading time.

⚠️

Risk NER

Named Entity Recognition trained to identify and classify financial risk disclosures — market, regulatory, operational, and liquidity risks.

💡 Pro tip: Paste the "Risk Factors" section from an annual report for the most actionable insights. This section contains the company's own legally-required risk disclosures.
